payload.title: Opossum Wall Art for Funny Housewarming Gifts
payload.description: A very distinguished little menace. This JAOYWAO canvas print puts a theatrically reclining opossum in a gold-colored frame. Visit Goose Gifts for its 8x10-inch format, ready-to-hang details and animal-lover housewarming fit. Console, vase, coat and keys are styling props, not included. AI-modified image. Affiliate disclosure: goose.gifts may earn from qualifying purchases.
payload.alt_text: Small landscape gold-colored frame containing a printed portrait of a reclining gray-and-white opossum with open mouth and curled pink tail, leaning on a walnut console against a dark teal wall. Ivory text reads 'FINALLY, AN HONEST FAMILY PORTRAIT'.
